load_prompt_template: load a markdown prompt template by name and substitute keyword placeholders with provided values
load_knowledge_context: load combined knowledge and platform prompt fragments for workflow agent context assembly
load_prompt_directory: load all markdown files recursively from a prompt subdirectory in sorted order
review_prompt_loading: review the prompt loading utilities to understand template substitution and directory-based prompt assembly
summarize_prompt_categories: summarize the prompt categories including supervisor, knowledge, platform, and phase prompts
